whenToUse: Permissions differ by person, as with shared documents, folders, or team spaces.
Problems from being signed in with another account are common.
Access can be requested within the app.
whenNotToUse: Content whose very existence must be hidden (respond with a 404).
Paid features that are locked (use locked content).
People aren't signed in (send them to sign-in).

alternatives.name: Locked Content
alternatives.reason: It can be unlocked with payment or membership.

alternatives.name: 404 Page
alternatives.reason: Even its existence mustn't be revealed.

accessibility: After a request, announce the result ("We'll email you when it's approved.") with role="status".
The request button turns disabled and its name changes to "Requested", stating the state in words.
The lock icon is decorative, so it's aria-hidden.
Show the signed-in account so people can notice for themselves if they chose the wrong one.
